description.en: Mega-menu featuring fluid layout morphing transitions and silky physics.
description.zh: 具液态形变平滑过渡与物理动效的现代 Mega-menu 导航组件。

content.en: Butter Nav is an exquisitely tuned mega-menu navigation component for React. Built with Motion and Tailwind CSS, it delivers fluid morphing container transitions, pointer-tracking pill highlights, and smooth height adaptations as users glide between dropdown categories.
content.zh: Butter Nav 是一套追求极致手感与物理流体形变的 React Mega-menu 导航组件。基于 Motion 与 Tailwind CSS 构建，当鼠标在不同菜单分类间滑移时，导航面板能实现如黄油般丝滑的容器尺寸平滑变形与磁吸高亮跟随，极富设计工程师审美。
